title: Decision matrix policy cases
description: Test cases for a ruleset: facts and saved answers, and the decision the rules must make. decision-matrix test runs them without a server. A case's facts merge over defaults.facts (nested objects merge too), its answers replace default answers by question id, and its thresholds replace default thresholds by name.
$comment: readCases in decision-matrix-cli accepts exactly the documents this schema accepts, and also checks that case names are unique. Answers are read with the same dialect tolerance as a server response (see PROTOCOL.md), so aliases such as a missing type are accepted. The facts and thresholds definitions match decision-matrix-rules' facts.schema.json and ruleset.schema.json, and a test keeps them equal.

defaults.description: What most cases share. A case lists only what differs.

expect.description: What the decision must be. Name at least one field. Only the named fields are compared.

matched_rule.description: A rule id, or null for the default action.

from_facts.description: True when the leading facts-only rules must decide without calling the server.

error.description: A substring of the error the case must raise, for example a missing fact.

answers.description: Saved answers keyed by question id, in the normalized form, for example { "type": "noul", "noul": 0.8 }.
